attribution.note: Zitron endorses the interpretation himself, although he attributes the underlying contract reporting to Semafor.

semantics.note: The proposition preserves his tentative interpretation of an existing relationship and the qualification on OpenAI's customer ranking. It makes no definite forecast.

contract.note: The contract fairly treats the main assertion as a hedged interpretation. Scoring disconnection or customer rank would require measures the speaker did not supply.

evidence.note: The report predates the cutoff and describes later partnership changes pointing both ways. It reports company disclosures and does not establish the meaning of the March 2025 contract change.
The summary was available before the cutoff. It reports company backlog disclosures as of March 31, after the statement, without ranking customers by contracted value.

reviews.rationale: The main assertion is explicitly tentative and supplies no measure of disconnection. Policy excludes such hedged interpretations from scoring. The customer-ranking aside also lacks a defined basis. Later partnership changes and incomplete backlog figures do not justify a definite verdict.
